title: AWS re:Invent Watch & Build Party by AWS User Group Mysuru
description: For the very first time, AWS User Group Mysuru brings the excitement of AWS re:Invent to Mysuru. Watch the keynotes and top announcements together, build in hands-on workshops and collaborative mini-hack sessions, and connect through mentorship, career guidance and networking with developers, architects and cloud leaders.
note: Free, with registration review and limited seats (200). Venue details coming soon.
